description: This file is a header file defining interface functions and macros for Realtek RTL826XB PHY hardware, including function declarations for reading and writing PHY registers, and conditionally including other headers depending on compilation options.

methods.name: rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_read
methods.description: Function for reading data from a specified PHY register using SDS protocol.

methods.name: rtk_phylib_826xb_sds_write
methods.description: Function for writing data to a specified PHY register using SDS protocol.
